summary: Rental Availability Finder MVP targets property managers, landlords, and housing authorities in Ashtabula County. The tool provides AI-powered rental matching and availability tracking. Target market includes both private property management companies and public housing authorities. Strong fit for organizations managing multiple properties who need streamlined tenant matching and availability updates.

leads.name: Ridgeview Estates
leads.fit_rationale: Local apartment community in Ashtabula managing multiple units. They have a structured application process and emphasize quiet, quality living. Would benefit from automated availability tracking and tenant pre-screening tools.

leads.name: Ashtabula Metropolitan Housing Authority (AMHA)
leads.fit_rationale: Official housing authority serving Ashtabula County with Section 8 vouchers, public housing, and USDA housing programs. Manages significant affordable housing inventory. Would benefit greatly from centralized availability finder and streamlined application portal.
leads.source: Web search - Ashtabula County housing authority

leads.name: DTS Property Management
leads.fit_rationale: Regional property management company serving 15+ Ohio counties with 100+ properties monthly. Offers property preservation, rehab, and junk removal. High-volume operator that would benefit from automated listing management and tenant matching.
leads.source: Web search - DTS Property Management Ohio

leads.name: Tucker Group Property Management
leads.fit_rationale: Local property management firm offering bespoke investment property strategies. Focuses on maximizing ROI for property owners. Would benefit from technology solutions that streamline tenant screening and reduce vacancy periods.
leads.source: Web search - Tucker Real Estate Ashtabula

leads.name: Western Reserve Properties
leads.fit_rationale: Established property management company in Madison, OH (Ashtabula County area) since 1939. Manages rental homes, apartments, and vacation properties. Offers full property management services including tenant screening and 24-hour maintenance. Would benefit from modern availability tracking and digital application processing.
leads.source: Web search - Western Reserve Properties Madison Ohio

aesthetics_and_layout_notes: Clean, centered layout appropriate for utility tool
Soft, neutral color palette (creams, soft blues) is safe and approachable
Card-based design is modular and easily adaptable
'Verified Rentals' badge builds trust but needs backend verification system

whitelabel_potential.reasoning: The MVP uses a generic, modular structure that can be easily adapted for any municipality, housing authority, or property management company. The neutral color scheme and centered card layout are highly reusable.
whitelabel_potential.adaptability: Swapping logo, regional name, and accent colors would allow deployment for any county or property management firm.
